name: Scheme for the Award of Scholarship for Post Graduate Students of Various Faculties of Junagadh Agricultural University
benefit: - **Master’s degree students:** ₹2,000/- per month for 2 years.  - **Ph.D. degree students:** ₹3,000/- per month for 3 years.
_eligibility_text: - Applicant must be domiciled in Gujarat. - Applicant must have obtained a minimum first-class or equivalent grade/OGPA in UG (for Master’s) or Master’s (for Ph.D.). - Applicant must be newly admitted (fresh) to the Postgraduate program at JAU. - Applicant must have a basic degree in Agriculture or allied sciences.
